tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on Separable and Modal Verbs

questions.question: Q: Rewrite with correct word order: Ich (einkaufen / gehen / am Samstag).
questions.correctAnswer: Ich gehe am Samstag einkaufen. (The separable prefix "ein-" goes to the END of the clause: ich gehe... ein.)

questions.question: Q: Translate: I must do my homework. I would like to go to the cinema.
questions.correctAnswer: Ich muss meine Hausaufgaben machen. (Modal + infinitive at end.) Ich möchte ins Kino gehen. (Modal + infinitive at end.)

tests.name: Extended Practice
tests.description: Self-marked extended answers on Separable and Modal Verbs

questions.question: Full-Mark Response Writing task: Write about separable verb prefixes (an-, aus-, mit-, zu-); modal verbs (können, müssen, dürfen, sollen, wollen, möchten); word order with modals. <div class="
questions.correctAnswer: A grade 9 answer will: use at least three tenses accurately; include complex structures (subordinate clauses, modal verbs, separable verbs); show precise grammar (cases, word order, adjective endings); express and justify opinions; include cultural knowledge about DACH countries; use a wide range of vocabulary; be well-organised with connecting words (außerdem, jedoch, trotzdem, zusammenfassend). Mark scheme: Content (relevance and detail) + Quality of language (accuracy and range) = total marks
questions.explanation: Extended answer: aim for the mark-scheme points, in order, with the command word addressed.
